description: Turn 1 asks one question in the question tray (AskUser, with two options) and ends its turn waiting; the answer (or 'User skipped this question.') wakes it and it replies with what it received.

steps.text: I need one decision from you first.

questions.question: Which colour should the banner use?

steps.text: I've asked in the question tray. I'll wait for your answer.
